title: feat(plugin-list): the shared field list also manages a view's fields, for the Options card

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：暂时没有。列表页共用的字段清单学会了管理字段：拖动或用键盘排序、点眼睛隐藏、点一下重新显示、添加新的列；要等「选项 → 字段」那张卡接上才会出现。
- 为什么：列表页重做专题只保留一个字段选择器，「选项 → 字段」直接用它，不再另做一份。
- 如果判断错：现在没有页面用到这些新本事，不影响任何列表，可以直接撤回。
- 需要您做的：无。

## What changes

This is step 1b, on top of step 1 (#35622, merged as 15f8357a2a). The branch merged `main` after that, so **this PR's diff against `main` is its own: 15 files, +511/-41.** Its consumer is #35551 (ux-3, Options → Fields), which will import `FieldList` in place of its own local copy. **No list mounts it yet, so this PR changes no behaviour.**

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/FieldList.tsx`: **the one shared field picker for the list redo.** All new props are optional. With none of them, the list is exactly the picker the filter and sort panels use: a listbox of options, where a hidden row picks. With them, the list becomes the view's field manager, and every change is handed back at once, with no Apply:
  - `order` / `onOrderChange`: the shown rows reorder by drag. They also reorder from a grip handle with ArrowUp/ArrowDown; the handle's accessible name is 「Move LABEL」, it is described by the arrow-key hint, and focus stays on it. `order` may name hidden fields too, and those keep their places when a shown field moves. Reordering is off while a search narrows the list.
  - `onHide`: an eye toggle on each shown row. `onShow`: one click on a hidden row shows it again.
  - `addable` / `onAdd`: fields that are not columns yet, listed under the hidden ones. One click adds one.
  - `searchPlaceholder`: the search box's placeholder and its accessible name.

  Field items are `{value, label, type?}`. A host holding `{name, label}` maps `name` to `value`. A `readable` flag is not read: per ADR-0098 §6 the host passes only readable fields.
- `conditionTranslations.ts` and the 11 locale packs: six `listConditions.fieldList.*` keys (not in the view yet, add, show, hide, move, the reorder hint). `zh-Hant.ts` is generated by `gen:zh-hant`.
- `.changeset/list-field-list-manager.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch. Step 1's changeset is left as step 1 wrote it.

## Tests

Tests migrated or retired: none. Platform-checklist items edited: none; the Options → Fields card wires the props and owns its items.

`listConditions.test.tsx` gains 8 tests (36 in all):
- a drag reorders and hands back the whole order;
- hidden fields named in `order` keep their places;
- the grip handle reorders by keyboard and keeps focus;
- reordering is off while searching;
- the eye hides a field, and one click shows it again;
- addable fields sit under the hidden ones, and one click adds one;
- a custom placeholder is the box's name;
- CONTROL: without the manager props there is no grip, eye or add section, nothing is draggable, the placeholder is 「Search fields」, and a hidden row still picks.

<details><summary>Test and type-check readings</summary>

- At e5ee237064, whose code is byte-identical to this head (the head adds only the changeset commit), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/ packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` gave `Test Files 105 passed (105)`, `Tests 1992 passed | 13 skipped (2005)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` both exit 0.
- Ablation ran at 620ea09619 through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0). Each restore matched the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Reorder hands back the order unmoved: vitest 3 failed (drag, hidden places, keyboard).
  - The eye toggle does not call `onHide`: vitest 1 failed (hide and show).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- This code was first pushed to #35622 and reverted there (1636c1c2d5), so that each PR stays under 3,000 lines.

## Verification

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `FieldList.tsx` (`moveTo` / `moveFieldInOrder`): the order a reorder hands back, with hidden fields kept in place.
2. `FieldList.tsx` (`actionOf`, `managing`): without the manager props the row roles and clicks are the picker's, unchanged.
3. `listConditions.test.tsx` (the field-manager CONTROL).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/conditions/` should end with `Tests 36 passed (36)`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived the same 40 families as at e5ee237064, where all 40 ran and exited 0; `--ran` gave 「40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」.
